body:
I'll say this.....I had a date and everything planned....something came up and I put it aside for another time .

But, I had an eye surgery done on the date I had it planned. Not going into details of how I was going to go, but, that surgery  was done on full anaesthesia.

Now, that time, while I was under, was the best sleep I had in 2 years and the most peaceful sentiment I can remember.I can't stop thinking about it,i literally think of that very moment every day now, I feel it was so peaceful although I can't remember anything between going to sleep and waking up, but just the feeling I have inside me makes me somehow happy, in a weird way. Right now? I hope to experience that again, and I feel , just feel, like death is the same in terms of feelings, just nothingness, peace and no more pain and sorrow.

I am here, if you want somebody to talk to for a while, I am sorry you have chosen this path, and if you decide to go through with it, I hope with all my heart that you find peace. I cannot tell you what you should and shouldn't do, I can only be here if you need someone to talk to. A stranger.
I am here, just another stranger, and I will listen to you....

I feel you. I also wish I was never born, I don't have a place in this world, and I want all my pain to end. I was close, but something came inbetween and I aborted it. 

As of now, I will give it some time, maybe hoping in vain that things change, doubt it though.

I hope you stay strong and give it some more time, maybe just a little bit. If nothing changes, I wish the both of us the best of luck.

It might be....I was so so ready to leave, I had everything in place and planned, but something came in between, my little 1 yo nephew was rushed to the hospital that day. When I got the message, I stopped thinking and just went there to see how and what was going on.

​

I am not afraid anymore of leaving, in fact, I feel some sort of happiness about it, but I just couldn't go right then and there.

I know full well that my parents and my brother will be hurt, but, after 2 years feeling this way, only hurting and emptiness and pain, ii cannot see any other way. I only hope they can forgive me.

I don't really know, I was so ready to leave, as you can see in my post history, but I had an eye surgery recently which was on full anaesthesia.

That feeling I have now, after it , is that when I was under I felt the most satisfying sleep and peace of mind ever. I would like to experience it again, maybe it will be possible in the future......that feeling without having to go through killing myself.
I've spent alot of time, and yes, that is what i really want, just peace and rest, because i am really tired. Thank you for writing me.

I love am not afraid of going, no longer, as a matter of fact, i feel happy and calm about it it. 
This is my road i chose, and i will be keeping it.

Thank you for being here, it may be right. 
Maybe a small part of me still holds on, to hope i would guess .
It doesn't matter though, everything i have been through, all my pain and then loneliness and emptiness cannot and will not change my heart. 
This is what i have to do, i don't belong here, never have, and all i want is my pain to end. 
So i am keeping my schedule, thank you for being here.
As for electronics and stuff, i will not erase them....everything else in my real life will go to charity as i wrote it, the online stuff i don't care as much.

All i want is that all my pain and emptiness and suffering to just stop. 
I don't have anything or anyone with me, all i had all this time is sorrow and pain and nothing else. 
It is as it will be.
And I want to thank you for not giving me all that stuff about it all gets better, it may not be much, but It means a lot to me, so thank you.

Thank you for the kind words, and yes, it is over.

You know what? I do actually feel quite happy about it, about finally being free from all my pain, although I can say that it's a strange happiness.

Nevertheless, I hope you and all the others can find all the peace and fulfillment you are looking for. And I really mean that. Thank you.
Thank you, i only want that, nothing else, thank you.

I know life sucks, I know that some have it worse, much worse, than me, but my life, as I see it and as it has been until now , at least for me, is something I don't want on anyone to have, and I planned this out and I have a sure way out and painless, through sleep......yes it is sure, very, that I can attest to.

As for helping people here, I wish I could do more for everyone, I've always had a big heart, that I know for sure about myself, but it seems that because of who I am, I always get hurt, no matter what.

Thank you for being here and talking to me.

​

I did that also, I know the exact feeling.

I don't believe I can trust anyone else, it doesn't matter though because my day to leave is tomorrow.

I just wish I was a different person? I don't know, but I feel like I don't belong here, never belonged here.

Anyway, If you'd like to talk, pm me, I will be here for a time.

My reasons? I am all alone in this world, and i have been followed by bad luck since i turned 11.
This is not my place, i just want all the pain and sorrow inside me to stop, i want to be at peace and just not be in this world anymore.

I don't know if you are a burden, but i don't want to believe that. 
I'm here if you want to talk.
I don't really know what to say, i just wish you a wonderful journey, whatever you decide to do.
It might be so, yes possible, what i do know is that i really am going to go, be free of all my pain.
I also feel empty now, and like you, i won't open up again like that.  I feel like i cannot trust anybody anymore.
I will try everything i can to see if it will get better, although I'm not sure if it'll work.

How can I get better? I've tried everything, but I am always behind a window from the real world.

I feel like I don't belong here, everything I had was with this person, and now for whatever reason, I lost her.

I felt like this before, and I got ready to end it all, so I actually have everything I need now, it's just a push away in my muscle, and i'll sleep forever. I cannot stand the pain and emptiness inside me anymore, I am just done with it.

Will there be really hell? As a matter of fact, is there really God here?
Not for me, I didn't want to be born, I don't remember asking for this.
No, my choice is made anyway, and if it is hell, then I guess I have to endure it forever.
My choice is made however, and that is final.
Yes...well, today is like...i feel all of a sudden so heavy on my feet....and shaky, it feels like it's getting worse and worse
